title: Dexcom G6 - No valid timestamp stored for transmitter
symptom: After using a Dexcom G6 transmitter and sensor for the first time, no readings were received after the 2-hour warmup. Attempts to stop and start the sensor failed, and eventually the sensor crashed and is now always Stopped. Logs show the message 'No valid timestamp stored for transmitter:8Gxxxx'.
evidence_quote: After 2h warmup no readings were recieved. Tried to stop and start the sensor without any luck After severla tries I got the message that the sensor crashed and now it is always Stopped.
